author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Right-facing swan like the reference: raised tail tip, back dipping into the neck notch, S-shaped outlined neck (about 9 wide) into a rounded head with a separate beak stroke, body closed by three water scallops. Hermite cubics; SQUARE extremes exact. Reads as a swan at 48 in both themes.
omissions: Reference's inner wing leaf lines dropped: the body is too small for a wing line 8 clear of the back and water; the leftmost partial wave scallop is dropped.
